# Upstream Review: Source And Date

Status: Draft
Owner: Yaacov
Last updated: 2026-07-18
Purpose: Records the inspected upstream range, dispositions, and any selected intake for one maintained Scient source.
Doc type: Research evidence

## Scope

When copying this template, replace the title and update `Last updated` to the
real review date.

- Owned repository and branch:
- Owned head inspected:
- Official repository and branch:
- Previous `reviewedThrough`:
- Observed official tip:
- Commit count:
- Review commands and evidence:

## Review Depth

State what was inspected and what was not proven. Advancing `reviewedThrough`
means every commit received a disposition; it does not imply execution,
integration, or a complete correctness/security audit.

## Dispositions

| Official commit | Classification | Disposition | Reason and follow-up |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<sha>` | `<class>` | Adopt / Adapt / Reimplement / Defer / Reject | ... |

## Intake Decision

State whether code was landed, selected for a later intake, or not wanted. List
exact source commits and owned PRs for any intake.
